retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style layout featuring a segmented rainbow arc containing duotone performance photos, anchored by a jagged lightning bolt and heavy drop-shadowed display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex composition where a multi-colored rainbow arc sweeps from the bottom left, containing a series of duotone photographic panels. The arc is bounded by a red lightning bolt motif on the left and a large, heavy-shadowed typographic block on the right, all set against a textured metallic grey background.
coreVisualRelationships: The rainbow arc acts as a container for the photographic narrative.
The lightning bolt provides a sharp geometric contrast to the circular arc.
The heavy display type balances the visual weight of the photo collage.
Color transitions in the arc correspond to the duotone tints of the photos within.
coreInvariants: Segmented arc containing monochromatic photographic imagery.
Textured neutral background providing high contrast for vibrant colors.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photo collage occupies the lower-left quadrant; the title dominates the upper-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red lightning bolt on the left edge serves as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the rainbow arc from the bottom left up toward the title text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper-left and center-right areas provide breathing room with a consistent grey texture.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Rainbow Spectrum (Red, Pink, Purple, Blue, Green)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements against a low-saturation, mid-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pastels; use deep, saturated 70s-era process colors.

letterConstructionRules: Deep, 45-degree offset drop shadows that create a 3D block effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'o' and 'e' have very small counters
Ascenders and descenders are truncated to maintain a compact block shape
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display block paired with clean, functional list-style sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and grotesque feel of the display type.
Provides the necessary verticality and thickness for the block shadow effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a textured grey background with a red lightning bolt on the left and a segmented rainbow arc containing duotone performance photos in the bottom left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add heavy, block-shadowed display text in the top right and a list of names in bold sans-serif in the top center.

verificationChecks: Is the rainbow arc segmented into duotone photos?
Does the display text have a deep, solid 3D block shadow?
Is the lightning bolt present on the left edge?
Is the background a consistent textured grey?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the photos are duotone and match the arc color.
Ensure the lightning bolt has sharp, clean angles.
Verify the text shadow is solid and not a soft drop shadow.
Confirm the background texture is subtle and metallic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a geometric arc container with duotone imagery and heavy, shadowed display type for a 1970s retro-modern aesthetic.
